Step into the role of Dillo, the ingenious armadillo with pinball expertise, in this dynamic 3D physics collectathon! Master mind-bending pinball structures and fast-paced movement as you roll through vibrant, sprawling worlds filled with intricate challenges. With every agile flip, bounce, and roll, unleash your creative strategies to overcome movement puzzles and destroy Rat King's forts. Rally your firefly friends scattered across diverse environments and prove that clever mechanics and bold determination can light up even the darkest corners of the world. Will your pinball prowess and quick wits save the day?

Roll Fast, Think Smart – Save the Fireflies!

In Dillo’s Dilemma, you play as Dillo, a clever armadillo who mastered the art of rolling into a high-speed pinball to navigate the world! Use your shell not just for defense, but for movement, puzzles, and offense!

Master the World of Pinball Movement

Traverse the environment with lightning-fast momentum using handcrafted pinball contraptions. Build and chain your own machines to create wild traversal paths and reach new achievements!

Explore Two Vast Worlds and a Vibrant Hub

Discover two different worlds – each packed with secrets, challenges, and hidden fireflies. Dive into mini-levels scattered across the overworld and return to your cozy home to prepare your next move.

Save Your Firefly Friends from the Rat King

The Rat King’s minions have taken over your homeland. Pinpoint their forts across the land, plan your route, and launch strategic assaults to rescue your captured friends!

Game Features

  • Momentum-based movement through rolling and bouncing physics.

  • Build and ride through pinball contraptions of your own making.

  • Two expansive worlds with layered mini-levels and a central Hub area.

  • Overworld forts to scout, plan, infiltrate, and destroy in your mission to save fireflies.

  • A colorful, stylized world full of secrets, shortcuts, and surprises.

  • Test your skills and complete your collection by finding all the hidden fireflies.
